words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.ex: He wants to join the football team.
words.en: To become a member of a group or organization; to connect or fasten things together.

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: They often play Chinese chess in the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们经常在周末去公园下中国象棋。
words.en: To engage in the game of xiangqi, a traditional Chinese board game similar to chess.

words.tr: n. 感觉； v. 感到；“feel”的现在分词；
words.ex: I have a feeling it will rain tomorrow.
words.en: An emotion or a physical sensation.

words.ex: I read the news every morning.
words.en: News is information about recent events or happenings, especially as reported by newspapers, radio, television, or online media.

words.tr:
adj. 音乐的；擅长音乐的；
n. 音乐剧；音乐歌舞片；
words.ex: He loves musical songs.
words.en: Relating to music; having the pleasant sound of music.

words.ex: He plays a musical instrument every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都演奏一件乐器。
words.en: A musical instrument is a device created or adapted to make musical sounds. In principle, any object that produces sound can be considered a musical instrument—it is through purpose that the object becomes a musical instrument.

words.tr: adv. 确切地；正是；准确地；
words.ex: He arrived exactly at 8 o'clock.
words.en: In a precise manner; accurately.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.tr:
n. 油漆；绘画颜料；
v. 刷油漆；画；
words.ex: The paint on the wall is peeling.
words.en: Paint is a coloured liquid that you put onto a surface with a brush in order to protect the surface or to make it look nice, or to produce a picture.

words.ex: The boy will climb the tree to get the ball.
words.en: To climb means to go up something, such as a mountain or a ladder, usually with some effort.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.tr:
v. 行动；表现；演戏；
n. 行动；法令；
words.ex: He acted quickly to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速行动救了那个孩子。
words.en: To do something for a particular purpose or in a particular way; to behave in a particular way; to have an effect or influence on something; to perform a part in a play, film, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 将...付诸行动；把…表演出来
words.ex: He didn't just talk about the plan—he decided to act it out.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅仅谈论这个计划，他还决定将它付诸行动。
words.en: To perform something, such as a play or a story, especially by acting; to express thoughts or feelings through actions.

words.ex: He is watching TV at home.
words.en: In or at one's own home.

words.tr: adj. 感兴趣的； v. “interest”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is interested in reading books.
words.en: If you are interested in something, you want to give your attention to it and learn more about it.

words.ex: He is interested in math.
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, wanting to learn or know more about it.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: He will arrive soon.
words.en: If something is going to happen soon, it will happen after a short time. If something happened soon after a particular time or event, it happened a short time after it.

words.ex: He is taller than his brother.
words.en: used to introduce the second element in a comparison

words.ex: He has more than three books.
words.en: Used to indicate that something is greater in amount, degree, or number than something else or than expected.

words.tr:
n. 头脑；意向；心；智力；
v. 介意；注意；
words.ex: He lost his mind after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了理智。
words.en: Your mind is your ability to think and reason. If you mind something, you are bothered by it or you object to it.

words.tr:
v. 下降；跌倒；
n. 落下；跌落；秋天；
words.ex: The temperature falls quickly at night.
words.en: To move downward, typically rapidly and freely without control, from a higher to a lower level.

words.ex: He falls in love with her when he sees her smile.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到她的微笑时，他就爱上了她。
words.en: To begin to feel romantic love for someone.

words.ex: He takes photos of the sunset every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拍夕阳的照片。
words.en: To capture images using a camera.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The insect flew over the grass.
words.en: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.
